title: Stranded at Sea in GTA 6? A Dog on a Jet Ski Rescues You 🐕 #Shorts
description:
Swim far out to sea in GTA 6 and, after about five minutes, you may hear barking: Cool Dog, a sunglasses-wearing dog on a jet ski, comes to rescue you. Stay on his jet ski past the shore and he takes you to a small island full of dogs, where players found a wallet with about $1,200. Reports say it doesn't trigger every time.

Sources: Gfinity ("GTA 6: How to Find Cool Dog"), Windows Central (funniest GTA 6 player clips), VGTimes.
Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
